---
title: "check-page-length.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, warn-only check that flags a page a pull request adds to
when the page has grown too long.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-10-31) is that a page should load and finish rendering its math
in under 5 seconds,
and that its scroll bar should not shrink to its smallest length.
A page that fails either goal is split into several pages.

## What it measures

The check runs without a browser, which the lab bans for agents,
so it measures two proxies on the *expanded* page,
the page's own text with each `{{< include >}}` shortcode replaced by the file it names:

- **Math expressions** (`max-math`, default 600).
  MathJax typesets every formula in the browser,
  so rendering time grows with the number of formulas.
  At roughly 8 ms per expression on a mid-range laptop,
  600 expressions is near the 5-second goal.
  Math inside code fences and HTML comments does not count.
- **Source lines** (`max-lines`, default 5000).
  A coarse proxy for rendered height, hence for the scroll bar's length.
  Semantic line breaks put about one sentence on a line.

## Decision record

These limits are estimates, chosen on 2026-10-31 from the lds corpus:
at 600 math expressions, 10 of lds's 40 chapters are over,
including every chapter Ezra named as slow.
The 8 ms per expression and the line limit are not measured.
To calibrate them, time MathJax on the expanded page in Node
(no browser) and set `max-math` to the count that finishes in 5 seconds.
Change the defaults in `check-page-length.py` and `action.yml` together;
a unit test pins that they agree.

## What it flags

A page (a `.qmd` file with a `title:`) over either limit,
when the pull request adds a non-blank line to the page or to a file it includes.
The finding sits on the first added line in the page itself,
or on line 1 when only an included file changed.
A page the diff did not touch is not reflagged, so nothing is swept.
`<!-- check-page-length: allow -->` anywhere in the page's own file exempts it.

With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to measure every tracked page in full.

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default    | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | ---------- | ----------- |
| `globs`        | string  | `'*.qmd'`  | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive by default). |
| `paths-ignore` | string  | `''`       | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip. |
| `max-math`     | string  | `'600'`    | Largest number of math expressions a page may have. |
| `max-lines`    | string  | `'5000'`   | Largest number of source lines a page may have, includes expanded. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `false`    | Fail the workflow when a touched page is over a limit. The default gives warning annotations only. |
| `whole-tree`   | boolean | `false`    | Measure every tracked page in full instead of only touched pages. |

## Usage

```yaml
jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-page-length.yml@v3
```

Copy [`examples/check-page-length.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-page-length.yml).
